title: Black Friday / Cyber Monday 2026 - AI game dev tool discounts ( images, 3D generation, video, music, voices)
author: imlo2
selftext:
I've been looking through Black Friday deals on various generative AI services, partly because I already use Higgsfield and Scenario and wanted to see what else might be worth considering.

Many of these tools are relevant to game development, I thought I'd share a compact overview to save others some time and usage credits if you would scrape for the same information.

No referral or affiliate links, this is my independent review. Feel free comment to add anything I've missed!

*Last updated: November 27, 2026. Prices generally in USD, excluding taxes. Advertised and reported offers are subject to availability; check the final price and terms before purchasing on the sites yourself!*

# 3D models & game assets

|Tool|Advertised deal|Price / notes|

|[Rodin / Hyper3D](https://hyper3d.ai)|50% off + bonus|Additional credits or subscription time. Until Dec 8.|
|[Tripo](https://www.tripo3d.ai)|Up to 60% off Teams|Also a reported 50% first-month offer for new individual users.|
|[Scenario](https://www.scenario.com)|Up to 60% off annual|Starter $120/year, Pro $216/year, Max $360/year. Custom model training, API access and multimodel asset workflows. See details below.|

# Scenario: asset workflows, agent access and actual credit consumption

From my own paid account on Nov 27 (*sale countdown points to around Nov 30*):

|Plan|Monthly equivalent|Annual cost|Credits/month|Advertised saving\*|
|:-|:-|:-|:-|:-|
|Starter|$10|$120|1,500|33%|
|Pro|$18|$216|5,000|60%|
|Max|$30|$360|10,000|60%|

\*Compared with the displayed reference prices of $15, $45 and $75/month respectively. Pro includes model training, a 10% compute discount and unlimited relaxed generations (web app only); Max adds a 20% compute discount and team features (additional seat fees apply).

I've mainly been testing Scenario for MCP-enabled agent workflows, where it's handy for generating stand-in 3D models and experimenting with different looks without interrupting development.

**Credit warning:** ***don't fall to the trap of thinking big numbers (credits) means a big generation budget - always go through the effort of converting a few credit costs to real money to understand the pricing better*** \- a single Seedance 2.5 video at 1080p and 30 seconds is quoted at 3,412 credits in my account. At that quoted rate, the Pro plan's 5,000 monthly credits cover just one such video (68% of the allowance), while Max covers two (34% per video). Actual costs may depend on the plan's compute discount and generation settings. For this reason, don't compare raw credit counts across platforms, and don't assume unlimited relaxed web generations apply to MCP/API requests, since in most cases they don't.

# Higgsfield: high-volume production and short-term passes

I can confirm the following from my own Creator account on Black Friday (Nov 27). Availability for other account types is not confirmed.

* **Secret 20K plan:** $258/month billed annually ($3,096 upfront), advertised as 70% off. 20,000 credits/month, equivalent to 10,000 Nano Banana Pro images OR approximately 1,333 Seedance 2.5 videos at the advertised credit rates. Compared with the Ultra 9K price shown in my account ($387/month), this is over twice the credits at a lower price. The included unlimited image-model offer lasts only 7 days. Secret plan offer ends Nov 28 at 00:00 UTC.
* **Credit packs:** 1,000 for $47.60, 2,000 for $89.25, 7,000 for $297.50 (up to 50% off among these examples). Extra credits expire after 90 days.
* **Unlimited concurrency add-on:** $5 for a year (75% off), for supported credit-based generations.

Selected Black Friday Market passes shown in my account:

|Unlimited pass|Duration|Price|
|:-|:-|:-|
|9 image models|1 / 3 / 7 days|$20 / $40 / $70|
|Kling 4.0 1080p|3 days|$91|
|Kling 4.0 4K|3 days|$223|
|Wan 3.0 1080p|3 days|$124|
|Seedance 2.0 720p / 1080p|3 days|$83 / $198|
|Seedance 2.5 720p / 1080p|3 days|$182 / $264|
|All 14 models|3 days|$304|

Individual video passes allow one concurrent generation; image passes allow two. Each image pass can be purchased once. The Market also advertises an extra discount on qualifying multi-item carts. Check eligibility, queue speeds, activation terms and final checkout pricing. The annual plan is a substantial commitment, while short passes could be useful for concentrated production runs.

# A few things worth checking before subscribing

* Actual annual cost vs. advertised monthly equivalent.
* Renewal prices - most discounts only cover the first billing period.
* Whether unused generation credits expire or roll over, and how much your actual model, resolution and duration cost in credits.
* Commercial licensing - especially for assets and music distributed with games.
* Whether the same models are already included in another subscription you have.
* Whether advertised unlimited generation is actually unlimited or subject to queues, fair-use limits and model restrictions.

Some advertised discounts include normal annual billing savings, so the actual Black Friday discount may be smaller. Some prices also come from reported deals and may vary at checkout.

Many of the reported offers end between November 28 and December 2, although some continue longer.

**What other deals have you found?**

I'd be particularly interested in tools for, as I didn't dig really deep or at all to these categories:

* Game-ready 3D models, retopology and rigging
* PBR materials and seamless textures
* Consistent characters, sprites and animations
* Music, environmental audio and sound effects
* ComfyUI hosting, GPU rentals and API credits
* AI coding tools

There might be new offers for Cyber Monday.
